summary: Meeting History Section - Action Buttons Testing. 13/14 tests passed. All meeting history UI features work correctly: table displays with correct columns, empty state, search, action dropdown, Share dialog, Delete dialog, conditional recording options. ONE BUG FOUND: View Details navigation goes to wrong route (/meetings/:id instead of /meeting/:id).

ui_bugs.issue: View Details navigation uses wrong route: navigates to /meetings/:id but route is /meeting/:id (singular)
ui_bugs.fix: Change line 76 from navigate(`/meetings/${id}`) to navigate(`/meeting/${id}`)

integration_issues.issue: MeetingScheduler's onSchedule callback in MeetingsPage only logs data but doesn't save to localStorage via localMeetingsStorageService.createMeeting()
integration_issues.note: This may be intentional (external testing found meetings DO save elsewhere) - but worth checking if scheduled meetings should appear in History

passed_tests: History tab renders 'Past Meetings' table with correct 6 columns
Empty state shows 'No meetings found' with helpful message
Search input with data-testid='meeting-history-search' present and functional
Action dropdown shows View Details, Download Recording, Share Recording, Delete for meetings WITH recording
Action dropdown shows only View Details and Delete for meetings WITHOUT recording
Delete opens confirmation dialog with 'Delete Meeting' title
Delete dialog has Cancel and Delete (destructive) buttons
Delete action removes meeting from table
Share Recording opens share dialog with copyable link
Table displays meeting title, ID, date/time, platform badge, participants avatars, recording status
Search filters meetings by title correctly
failed_tests: View Details navigation - navigates to /meetings/:id which shows 'Page not found' (route is /meeting/:id)
